test_cdist: test the DistanceMetric pairwise function computes distances matching scipy cdist for multiple metrics and input formats
test_pdist: test the DistanceMetric pairwise function computes self-distances matching scipy cdist for multiple metrics and input formats
test_haversine_metric: test the haversine DistanceMetric computes geodesic distances between coordinate pairs correctly
test_pickle: test the DistanceMetric object can be pickled and unpickled while preserving pairwise distance results
test_pyfunc_metric: test the pyfunc DistanceMetric wraps a custom callable function and produces distances matching predefined metrics
